finding: A healthy generated fake-runtime fixture inherited a 2000 ms exchange deadline and exceeded it on the Windows CI runner. The host correctly reported an uncertain timeout; the intended counter-reset assertion then observed zero admitted bytes.

onlyFailedCheck.name: a fresh host session starts with an independent zeroed inspection counter

failure.errorMessage: Request delivery and response did not both complete before the single exchange deadline. Execution outcome is uncertain; do not retry automatically, inspect persisted project state first.
failure.automaticRetry: never; inspect authoritative stored state after any uncertain outcome

change.scope: Verifier fixture defaults only; no runtime host default or semantic assertion changed.
change.rationale: The generated fake child is launched through the verifier subprocess path, and ordinary healthy fixture startup can exceed two seconds on Windows CI. Fifteen seconds allows the request and response to exercise the intended protocol assertion; a thirty-second outer budget accommodates subprocess startup and cleanup without replacing an exchange timeout with an automatic retry.
